claims: Carlos Boozer is a former NBA All-Star.
Carlos Boozer has twin sons named Cameron Boozer and Cayden Boozer.
Cameron Boozer and Cayden Boozer were born on July 18, 2007.
Cameron Boozer and Cayden Boozer currently play for Duke University.
Duke University is Carlos Boozer's alma mater.
Cameron Boozer and Cayden Boozer were high school recruits at Columbus High School in Miami.
Cameron Boozer and Cayden Boozer committed to Duke.
Cameron Boozer and Cayden Boozer play for the Duke Blue Devils.
Carlos Boozer and their mother CeCe are regularly seen supporting Cameron Boozer and Cayden Boozer at their Duke games.
Cameron Boozer and Cayden Boozer have an older brother named Carmani Boozer.
Cameron Boozer and Cayden Boozer were conceived via IVF to be a genetic match for their older brother Carmani Boozer.
Carmani Boozer had sickle cell anemia.
Stem cells from Cameron Boozer and Cayden Boozer's umbilical cords were used to cure Carmani Boozer, according to Instagram reports.
